title: Trump wanted to give No Kings no air. Then, Meta suspended its Instagram.
gist: Meta's automated systems suspended the No Kings Coalition's Instagram account for four hours during an October 17 early-voting push, blaming a Claude-powered tool whose activity looked like a bot. Meta told the group it has 'no plans' to change over-enforcement policies. The incident has led 14 state attorneys general and several lawmakers to press Meta, and has fed suspicion of political influence because of Meta's closer ties to Trump.

insights.claim: Meta's Andy Stone said the No Kings account was suspended because a Claude AI tool was 'reading profiles, posts, and hashtags', which sharply increased activity in bursts that resembled automated bot traffic.

insights.so_what: Platform anti-bot systems are colliding with legitimate AI-agent use, a friction point for the agent economy.
